name: vCard Projection
description: Pure WASM vCard 3.0 projection of $EPM (§21 literal-key), typed contracts 1.0: card_full (full contact card + verification chain + photo) and card_compact (QR-density card: sign/encrypt/epmsig only) emit one $VCF whose CARD is the vCard text verbatim; card_parse reads a $VCF's CARD and emits one $EPM carrying the recovered fields. Every frame is a size-prefixed SDS FlatBuffer. No capabilities: this module performs no I/O, no signing, no key derivation.

sequentialJustification.detail: vCard 3.0 text projection of $EPM to $VCF and back — stateless record transform, no host calls, no threading

acceptedTypeSets.description: Size-prefixed $EPM FlatBuffer record (the node's signed identity record).
Size-prefixed $VCF: FORM FULL, CARD = the UTF-8 vCard 3.0 text verbatim (CRLF, 75-octet folding), MEDIA_TYPE text/vcard, CONFORMANCE {VERSION 3.0, LINE_ENDING CRLF, FOLD_OCTET_WIDTH 75, BYTE_LENGTH}.

outputPorts.description: The projected card as one $VCF record.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Size-prefixed $VCF: FORM COMPACT, CARD = the UTF-8 vCard 3.0 text verbatim (CRLF, 75-octet folding), MEDIA_TYPE text/vcard, CONFORMANCE {VERSION 3.0, LINE_ENDING CRLF, FOLD_OCTET_WIDTH 75, BYTE_LENGTH, BYTE_BUDGET 1200, WITHIN_BYTE_BUDGET}.

outputPorts.description: The projected card as one $VCF record.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Size-prefixed $VCF; its CARD (vCard 3.0 text) is parsed.

inputPorts.description: The $VCF card to parse back into EPM fields.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Size-prefixed $EPM carrying only the recovered fields: DN (FN), LEGAL_NAME (ORG), JOB_TITLE (TITLE), EMAIL (contact EMAIL), TELEPHONE (TEL), FAMILY_NAME / GIVEN_NAME (N), and KEYS {PUBLIC_KEY = lower-case hex of the sign / encrypt alias's b64url local part, KEY_TYPE Signing / Encryption}. Unsigned: SIGNATURE is not recovered.

outputPorts.description: The recovered EPM fields as one $EPM record.
